title: Spectral geometric mean and trace characterizations
summary:
We use nearly parallel pure states to characterize positive linear functionals $φ$ on $\mathbb{M}_n$ as positive multiples of the trace if and only if $φ(A 
atural B) \leq \sqrt{φ(A) φ(B)}$ for all positive definite matrices $A$ and $B$. Here $A 
atural B = (A^{-1} \# B)^{1/2} A (A^{-1} \# B)^{1/2}$ represents the spectral geometric mean. For further clarification, we establish novel characterizations through the inequality $φ(A
